insert into ops.weekly_scorecard (week_start, kpi, detail, value)
select t.week_start, v.kpi, '', v.value
from (select (date_trunc('week', current_date) - interval '7 days')::date as week_start) t
cross join lateral (
    select 'files_loaded' as kpi, count(distinct source_file)::numeric as value
    from raw_deltafiles.off_product
    where date_trunc('week', to_timestamp(split_part(source_file, '_', 3)::bigint))::date = t.week_start
    union all
    select 'rows_staged', count(*)::numeric
    from staging.stg_product
    where date_trunc('week', to_timestamp(split_part(source_file, '_', 3)::bigint))::date = t.week_start
    union all
    select 'rows_rejected', count(*)::numeric
    from raw_deltafiles.rejected_row
    where date_trunc('week', to_timestamp(split_part(source_file, '_', 3)::bigint))::date = t.week_start
) v
on conflict (week_start, kpi, detail)
do update set value = excluded.value, computed_at = now();

insert into ops.weekly_scorecard (week_start, kpi, detail, value)
with t as (
    select (date_trunc('week', current_date) - interval '7 days')::date as week_start
),
checked as (
    select count(*) as staged_rows
    from staging.stg_product s
    cross join t
    where date_trunc('week', to_timestamp(split_part(s.source_file, '_', 3)::bigint))::date = t.week_start
),
fails as (
    select t.week_start, d.rule_id, r.dimension, d.barcode, d.source_file
    from dq.dq_failure d
    join dq.dq_rule r using (rule_id, rule_version)
    cross join t
    where r.counts_against_score
      and date_trunc('week', to_timestamp(split_part(d.source_file, '_', 3)::bigint))::date = t.week_start
)
select week_start, 'rule_rows_affected_pct', rule_id,
       round(100.0 * count(distinct (barcode, source_file)) / (select staged_rows from checked), 2)
from fails
group by week_start, rule_id
union all
select week_start, 'rows_affected_pct', dimension,
       round(100.0 * count(distinct (barcode, source_file)) / (select staged_rows from checked), 2)
from fails
group by week_start, dimension
on conflict (week_start, kpi, detail)
do update set value = excluded.value, computed_at = now();
